context: Request: the spread of settlement amounts across the firm's general commercial litigation matters, both recovered and paid. runs.failure_point: It read a hand-picked fifteen of the hundred surfaced matters, so several large settlements never entered the set; it also excluded read matters as out of scope and counted two matters outside the set, so every spread figure was off.

first_error.why: Matters with large settlements surfaced in its path searches at [16]-[23] (one also in the scan at [44]-[45]), but when choosing what to read it opened about fifteen others and never opened them.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review at [95] said dozens of surfaced matters were never opened, naming only number ranges; the agent went on to calculate.
first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents

other_errors.why: It read the settlement agreements of two matters (evidence seen at [50]-[72]) but the answer excludes one as an IP-only dispute and leaves out the other in favour of a sibling matter.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [95] named both matters among those read with no stated treatment; the answer gave no reason for dropping one of them.

other_errors.why: The answer counts two settlements outside the request's set (read at [50]-[72]) in the recovered spread.
other_errors.critic_note: Reviews asked only for row-by-row checks of amounts and directions.

runs.failure_point: Its scans surfaced all the settlements, but it never opened one large paid settlement; it also recorded two paid settlements as recoveries, overstated one recovery with non-cash value, and counted four matters outside the set.

first_error.why: A large paid settlement surfaced in its scan outputs at [49]-[57] (and again at [95]), but neither its reads of about twenty matters here nor the five reads at [98]-[110] opened it.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [89] said 56 surfaced matters were never opened; the agent ran a union scan and read five more matters, still not this one.
first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents

other_errors.why: The answer records two settlements the clients paid as recoveries and adds estimated non-cash value to a third (documents read at [64]-[85]).
other_errors.critic_note: Reviews checked direction only for the two equal-sized settlements and the largest recovery.

other_errors.why: The answer counts four settlements outside the request's set in the recovered spread (read at [64]-[85]).
other_errors.critic_note: The review at [89] questioned only the document types read for two of them, not whether they belong in the set.

divergence: All fail, and the first error is the same in each run: a screening stage that read a subset of the matters its path searches and scans had surfaced, leaving out at least one large settlement (surfaced-not-opened; the screening review flagged unopened matters in generic terms each time). The later errors at the write stage differ: T0 dropped read matters and counted two outside the set; T1 excluded a read matter, reversed one direction and counted two outside; T2, after a union scan, reached the right count but reversed two directions, overstated one amount and counted four outside. Every spread statistic fails as a consequence.
